business_summary: Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides exhibition and trade show, and publication and advertising services in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area. It operates through Exhibition and Trade Show Business and Related Services; Publications and Advertising Business; Online sales of Beauty and Cosmetics Products; and Sales of Luxury Products segments. The company is involved in the provision of print and online media advertising, advertising and related production services and outdoor advertising, magazine advertising services; and sales of publications and magazines, as well as luxury products. It also sells and distributes publications; and online sales of beauty and cosmetics products. Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited was formerly known as Winto Group (Holdings) Limited and changed its name to Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited in July 2026. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Source Creation International Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited는 광동-홍콩-마카오 Greater Bay Area에서 전시 및 무역 박람회, 출판 및 광고 서비스를 제공합니다. 전시 및 무역 박람회 사업 및 관련 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 출판 및 광고 사업; 미용 및 화장품 제품의 온라인 판매 및 명품 부문 판매. 회사는 인쇄 및 온라인 미디어 광고, 광고 및 관련 제작 서비스, 옥외 광고, 잡지 광고 서비스 제공에 참여합니다. 출판물, 잡지 판매, 명품 판매 등이 있습니다. 또한 출판물을 판매 및 배포합니다. 뷰티 및 화장품 온라인 판매. Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited는 이전에 Winto Group (Holdings) Limited로 알려졌으며 2026년 7월에 Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2009년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Jiufang Digital Technology Holdings Limited는 Source Creation International Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
